title: Supply Chain Brain: Data-Driven OFAC Enforcement: The Pivotal Role of Recordkeeping and Reporting
summary: Supply Chain Brain shares insights from Descartes' Jackson Wood on why robust recordkeeping and reporting are essential as OFAC enforcement becomes increasingly data-driven. As regulators leverage advanced analytics to identify sanctions compliance risks, organizations need accurate records, auditable processes and trusted trade data to strengthen compliance and reduce exposure.
body_markdown:
Supply Chain Brain shares insights from Descartes' Jackson Wood on why robust recordkeeping and reporting are essential as OFAC enforcement becomes increasingly data-driven. As regulators leverage advanced analytics to identify sanctions compliance risks, organizations need accurate records, auditable processes and trusted trade data to strengthen compliance and reduce exposure.
